verdict.summary: Typed SourceEvidence was exact. All eight evidence-absent fallback fixtures were non-exact, exposing narrow sentence templates, an internal syntax-versus-terminal-profile fork, and incomplete clause scoping. Eight oracle semantic targets also exceeded the authority contract and remain immutable as authored.

typedEvidence.finding: All 276 typed-evidence field assertions were exact. Typed facts remained authoritative over hostile prose, opaque capability identity was preserved, and all results used the canonical Observation and judgment path.

structuralFallback.finding: After rejecting seven raw mismatches whose frozen values were contract-correct, 56 semantic, 30 judgment, and nine decision defects remain. The eighth rejected target is bounded-source evidence strength: the oracle expected qualified and Core returned weak, while the contract-correct target is strong.

fixtureAdjudication.finding: A complete zero-exit command record is a low successful outcome even under failed transport status.
A complete nonzero outcome with excluded diagnostic channels is not a runtime diagnostic and retains explicit failed-status authority.
Present-but-empty output channels establish absent evidence and explicit failed-status authority.
The runtime diagnostic correctly outranked pending-authorization prose, but the legacy terminal profile lost command subject and command-output origin.
The measured partial source window must become a stable source-limit diagnostic. Core's explicit authority is correct; its weak strength and remaining semantic projection are not.
The complete returned document is a payload; quotation and hypothetical language scope diagnostic-looking text to the document instead of the event.
Required authorization, non-started execution, and absent result form a complete low control observation.
The derived indeterminate status observation is engine-owned while the explicit failed status remains its authority.

correctionPolicy: Leave typed SourceEvidence lowering, normalization, judgment, and planning unchanged.
Compile evidence-absent event facts into the existing TaskFailureObservationSyntax instead of adding a preprocessor or evaluator.
Separate outcome-only, absent, partial, and unknown evidence loss from clause-scoped event facts.
Derive command, source, document, and control roles from event shape, never capability identity.
Make asserted terminal diagnostics outrank success, payload, and control while suppressing quoted, hypothetical, conditional, future, documentation, and reference clauses.
Converge complete structural syntax and the legacy terminal profile before authoring a fresh V5 oracle.
Do not edit or relabel the V4 oracle or first-run artifact.
